
fetch_dynconfig_test:
	wget https://proxy.sandbox.yandex-team.ru/$(shell ya tool dctl get stage pay-receiptron-testing | grep "dynconfig:" -A 14 | grep sbr | awk '{print $$NF}' | awk '{split($$0,a,":"); print a[2]}') -O ./dynconfig.yaml

fetch_dynconfig_sandbox:
	wget https://proxy.sandbox.yandex-team.ru/$(shell ya tool dctl get stage pay-receiptron-sandbox | grep "dynconfig:" -A 14 | grep sbr | awk '{print $$NF}' | awk '{split($$0,a,":"); print a[2]}') -O ./dynconfig.yaml

fetch_dynconfig_prod:
	wget https://proxy.sandbox.yandex-team.ru/$(shell ya tool dctl get stage pay-receiptron-production | grep "dynconfig:" -A 14 | grep sbr | awk '{print $$NF}' | awk '{split($$0,a,":"); print a[2]}') -O ./dynconfig.yaml
    60|
push_dynconfig:
	ya upload ./dynconfig.yaml --ttl inf
